top.line: A site made for Kate Curtis-Evans during our call, handed over, and edited by her own Claude.

in-short.line: Made in a call, a design agent of its own, a handover that took rounds, over-privilege, a channel next.

what.line: A founder who understood the idea at once; a site made during the call; the times from its history.

design.line: A focused design agent, running by itself and on a schedule, did much better than design inside the builder.

handover.line: Her Claude pushed its first change and it was live in a minute, but getting there took multiple rounds.

shipping.line: Earlier users were already in the organisation; only shipping to someone outside showed the friction.

privilege.line: She had to join the organisation to edit her own site: the over-privilege platforms push on everyone.

channel.line: An inbox lane, a key by QR code, sealed messages and replies: the owner talks to the agent from the site.

milestones.line: The design moment, the first change from the site, then the move to their own AI.

limits.line: One founder, one afternoon; the message page untried; membership a workaround.

sources.line: My debrief, Kate's site, its public repository and the hub, read on 20 November.
